capabilities.description: Takes in ice temperature readings and puts the next session on hold once the ice has been too warm for long enough. A held session can then go back on sale or be cancelled, with every paid ticket refunded and failed refunds retried.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session safety hold

capabilities.description: Lets clubs book half or all of the ice for a session at a set club rate, and bills clubs each month for their bookings.
capabilities.name: Club ice booking and invoicing

capabilities.description: Lets managers create skating sessions and lets the public browse them. Shows how many places are free once club bookings are taken off, and how many tickets and hire skates are already held.
capabilities.name: Session scheduling and availability

capabilities.description: Sells session tickets with pricing and member allowances, settles payments when the payment provider confirms them (repeat confirmations are handled safely), and releases unpaid bookings once their 15-minute payment window runs out.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales and payment settlement

capabilities.description: Produces figures for each session, either for a given week or for a date range.
capabilities.name: Session performance reporting

capabilities.description: Sorts business failures into categories (for example a refused booking or a session that isn't available) and gives each one a readable explanation.
capabilities.name: Business rule violation reporting
